audit.why: Lane difficulty reads correctly: Akshan owns levels 2-6 against a champion with no ranged answer, Singed flips it on tank items. 57.14% over 14 games supports the early-lane ownership.

Spikes are correctly placed: Akshan at Lvl 2-3 (Q online), Lvl 6 (Comeuppance), first item (Youmuu's lethality); Singed at 2+ items when his HP pool outgrows lethality. Kept, only the ability slots inside them were wrong.

audit.whatIsWrong: The text calls Fling his W in six places. Fling is Singed's E (125 range, 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s). His W is Mega Adhesive. Worse, the decisive interaction is never stated: Mega Adhesive GROUNDS, and grounding locks out Heroic Swing (E) — Akshan's only escape and his entire trade pattern.
audit.why: Riot's Data Dragon text for Mega Adhesive: slows and grounds enemies who walk on it; Fling's text: flings target behind Singed, and if they land in his Mega Adhesive they are also rooted. Grounding is the single mechanic that turns this from a free lane into a death sentence, and the page did not mention it once.
audit.corrected: Fling is E on a 10s rank-1 cooldown. Mega Adhesive (W) grounds — standing on it disables Heroic Swing (E). Fling into the adhesive also roots. Never trade while standing on goo.

audit.whatIsWrong: No real cooldown numbers anywhere; 'low Q cooldown' is vague.
audit.why: Avengerang is 9/8/7/6/5s and Fling is 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s — those numbers make the step-up window concrete.
audit.corrected: Q is 7s at rank 3; Fling is 10s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: Grounding vs Heroic Swing never stated.
audit.why: Grounded disables dashes, blinks and movement abilities; Heroic Swing is Akshan's only mobility and his primary damage pattern.

edits.before: Singed has no ranged poke, so levels 2-3 are yours — your passive second shot and Q (Avengerang) chip him every time he steps into melee to last-hit, and with no way to shoot back he just has to eat it. Two catches: his W fling is a displacement, so respect that he can flip you back into the gas if you over-step, and he'll often proxy the wave behind your tower instead of standing in lane, leaving you poking empty space. Don't chase him into the poison trail for a Q — last-hit, hold your E (Heroic Swing) as your out, and play the lane on your terms.
edits.after: Singed has no ranged poke, so levels 2-3 are yours — your passive second shot and Q (Avengerang) chip him every time he steps into melee to last-hit, and with no way to shoot back he just has to eat it. Two catches: Fling (E) is a 125-range displacement on a 10s cooldown, so never over-step while it is up, and he'll often proxy behind your tower, leaving you poking empty space. Worse, Mega Adhesive (W) grounds you — standing on it locks out Heroic Swing (E), your only out. Never fight on the goo.

edits.before: This is your window. With E up for poke and escape and a low Q cooldown, you out-trade him hands-down — he can't return damage, so step up, Q, fire your passive shot, and back off before he can fling. At 6 your R (Comeuppance) turns any trade lethal: bait the W, and when he tries to walk off on his move speed, lock R on and let the missing-HP scaling execute him through the run-down. Your Youmuu's spike is the takeover — kill him, reset E off the takedown, and convert his proxy into a deficit before his drain-tank items come online.
edits.after: This is your window. With E up for poke and escape and Q down to 7s at rank 3, you out-trade him hands-down — he can't return damage, so step up, Q, fire your passive shot, and back off before Fling (E) is in its 125 range. At 6 your R (Comeuppance) turns any trade lethal: bait Fling, step clear of any Mega Adhesive so your swing stays live, then lock R on and let the missing-HP scaling execute the run-down. Your Youmuu's spike is the takeover — kill him, reset E off the takedown, and bank the proxy deficit.

edits.before: R (Comeuppance) locks on and ramps with his missing HP — bait the W fling, and when he tries to walk off on his speed, channel the execute through the run-down before he's tanky.
edits.after: R (Comeuppance) locks on and ramps with his missing HP — bait Fling (E), and when he peels off on Noxious Slipstream (P) speed, channel the execute through the run-down before he's tanky.

edits.before: - Singed Fling: matchup-defining — The flip into his goo — never chase into range while it is up. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget E swing for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Singed Fling (E), 10s: the flip into Mega Adhesive (W), which roots — step up only on its downtime. - The goo also grounds, so it disables Heroic Swing entirely; never stand on it with E as your planned exit.
